# Changelog

All notable changes to the Οργανική Ονοματολογία MuLERMoC.

---

## [v57] (3D atom/bond picking via JSmol pickCallback; LIVE, `index.html` → v57)

Forked from v56 (`mulermoc-nom-57.html` + `js/*-57.js` + `css/*-57.css` + `jsme-nick-nomeclature-moc2-data_57.js` + `spt/init-3-57.spt` + `zz-test-core57.html`, `?v=57.0`; `ui-icons.js` stays shared). v56 files untouched. No chemistry changes (`core-57.js` is a byte copy of `core-56.js`).

### 3D picking (v57 working tree)
- Spike (owner-run, corrected against bundled sources): `set pickCallback` delivers `(htmlName, strInfo, atomIndex, map)` — the page function is applied to the data array. Each atom click fires twice (bitset echo with index -1, then the authoritative 0-based index); each bond click fires once with index -3 and a `["bond", identity, x, y, z]` payload, but only with `set bondPicking true` (the reporting path needs the flag; without it bond clicks are silent). `show picked` reads back empty; drag-rotate emits no callback.
- `window.__mulerPickCb` (`molview-57.js`): armed/draft/Present/molecule guards; the page function receives `(htmlName, strInfo, atomIndex, map)` — `>= 0` toggles that atom, `-1` is the bitset echo (ignored, exactly-once per click), `-3` reports a bond with a `["bond", identity, x, y, z]` payload (identity head = 1-based bond position, `#N` pair = endpoint atomnos, cross-validated against `bondList3D`). Bond picks mirror into `bonds2D` and are ignored by atoms-only quizzes; armed H picks fold onto the heavy parent in state and paint (mirrors the 2D armed pick), except target hydroxyl/aldehyde H which stays atomic and is now selectable from 3D. Free-mode H picks mirror H↔H by sibling rank in bond-list order (the connectivity table has no H rows, so all H neighbor lookups use the live `bondList`/`bondList3D` instead).
- Mirror-at-toggle both directions through the cached heavy map (`fMulerHeavyMapCached`, same discipline as `fTranslateChain2D3D`): 3D picks land in `atoms2D/bonds2D` too, so quiz compare/refresh/verdicts work unchanged. Unmappable atoms fail closed (3D-only record, documented).
- Paint: `fMulerSelectPush3D` strict full-rebuild cyan (`MULER_SELECT_CYAN`) via `fMulerSelectPaintSets3D` — atom picks paint atoms only, bond picks paint exactly the picked bonds (never endpoints/cross-highlight, 2D parity); condensed/skeletal group completion is paint-only (fully-selected compacted fragments add member heavies + internal 3D bonds, every picked heavy adds H neighbors + C-H bonds, skeletal branch picks add the whole alkyl branch off `mainChainAtoms3D`); condensed 3D atom picks delegate to the 2D unit (whole fragment, or anchor-only under main-chain carbon rule) through the shared toggle. Empty state is a no-op (never auto-resets, reward-green safe); skipped when off/Present. Picking scoped to armed sessions (`set picking atom` + `set bondPicking true`), appended to both `fLoadMol3D` scripts so `init-3-57.spt` (`picking OFF`) cannot override; restored on disarm.
- 3D background double-tap clear: single silent taps do nothing (bond tap vs background is unknowable page-side); a second silent tap within ~450ms/~8px clears via the 2D empty-canvas path. Any genuine pick breaks the chain, so fast atom picking can never misfire it; empty state never fires (mirrors the Esc guard), so no spurious `select all` console echoes.
- No automatic chain numbering while selecting: arming never paints locants in either viewer (leftover 2D badges are wiped by the re-render; 3D echoes were never painted). Instead, picked carbons show pick-sequence numbers in cyan in both viewers — 2D `mulerSelNum` badges and new 3D `mulerSelSeq3D` echoes (`fMulerSelectSeq3D`, rebuilt per repaint, main-chain purpose only, auto-renumbered on toggle, cleared on disarm/empty/exact). 3D settings toggles (`showAtomSymbols3D`, `showHydrogens3D`) no longer resurrect classic 3D numbering while armed (viewer-owns-viewer guard). Verdict line is class-only now (`mulerQuiz-<kind>` + `mulerQuiz-hidden`; the stale `col = "var"` inline override is gone) — restyle freely under `#mulerQuizVerdict` in `css/jsme-nick-57.css`, seeded to match the previous rendered colors.
- Quiz progress tints (armed only): quiz-capable unsolved components get `.quizTodo` (`--veryLightEarth`); solved boxes return to default white and fall back to the classic path with active highlights (the viewer-owns-viewer guard admits solved modes, so green + numbering + explanation paint even while armed; unsolved modes and deselect stay quiet). Solved boxes never re-arm. Per-molecule solved sets (`window.__mulerQuizSolved`), cleared when select mode toggles off (fresh round); hydrocarbon `-io` and other atom-less boxes stay default. Chain-first redirects skip solved chains (stash task arms directly).
- Headless 3D regression probe `tools/muler-harness/probe-3d-pick.js` (atom/bond/mirror/double-tap/quiz-exact/model-unchanged; model-load gate + settle polling for slow applets). Browser run pending on a machine with working 3D.
- `node --check` clean on all 9 v57 JS files (`node.exe` v26.13.1 via Windows path); skew identical to v56. Browser re-test pending: arm → tints on quiz-capable boxes only; solve chain → white + green, click replays classic without re-arming; branch atom outside chain stays silent, target armed; switch molecule → tints follow per-molecule progress; toggle select off/on → fresh round; 2D/3D pick-sequence numbers track renumbering and disarm/exact cleanup; full regression.

## [v56] (2D atom/bond selection entry; authoring-only, `index.html` → v55)

Forked from v55 (`mulermoc-nom-56.html` + `js/*-56.js` + `css/*-56.css` + `jsme-nick-nomeclature-moc2-data_56.js`, `?v=56.0`; `ui-icons.js` stays shared). v55 files untouched, v55 stays live.

### Main-chain quiz bond picking
- Bond hover and clicks are disabled while the main-chain quiz is armed; bond clicks leave existing picks intact. Atom picking and free-selection bond behavior remain unchanged. The viewer script URL is cache-busted to `?v=56.2`.

### Chemistry review fixes (v56 working tree, 2026-11-13)
- Review report: `docs/REVIEW-CORE-MOLVIEW-56.md`. Regression page `zz-test-core56.html` (141 stored molecules + 3D mirror identical to HEAD; 31 drawn probes pass).
- `core-56.js`: numeric locant sorts; multi-group naming rewritten per substituent type (halogens now named as prefixes, principal alcohol/ketone locant emitted); fail-closed whitelist of supported elements/groups (`fDeclineNaming` for amines, imines, nitroso, S/P, ether/ester mixes, multi-FG + C=C); polynitro multiplier; nitro detection tightened (exactly C + 2 O) and nitro O no longer misread as ketone/aldehyde (2D and 3D); `fAnchorCarbonOf` for nitro anchors; only the senior of alcohol/ketone/amine is "principal" for numbering; acid outranks ester for C1.
- `molview-56.js`: expanded-mode hydrogen picks remain distinct hydrogen atoms in quiz comparisons; the proposed H-to-carbon fold was reverted. Its script URL is cache-busted to `?v=56.1`.

### Selection-mode button (v56 working tree, 2026-11-12)
- New `MuLERIcons.selectAtoms` (from `imgs/mouse-click-svgrepo-com.svg`; shared registry, additive — no v55 impact). `#selectAtomsBtn` first in the title bar (`molview-56.js`), `window.MulerUserSelection.active` flag (`fToggleAtomSelect`), pointer cursor on `#jsmeNomeclatureSVG.selecting` (owner choice).
- Gated by new Ρυθμίσεις "Allow selections" (`allowSelect`, default checked; fail-open); entry hidden when off, unchecking while active exits the mode. Dimmed with no molecule (mirrors Edit), blocked mid-draft (`draftLocked` toast), hidden in Present.
- Draft entry (Edit/New) force-exits select mode and dims the button (`btnInactive`, cursor class cleared); teardown restores via the normal reselect → sync path. Verified live (on → Edit → dimmed/off → Cancel → restored).
- Phase 1B — 2D click selection (v56 working tree): delegated clicks on `#jsmeNomeclatureSVG` (armed mode only; draft/Present/no-molecule guarded) resolve atoms via the established order maps and bonds via `svgBondList` index ranges, with topological vertex fallback for unlabeled skeletal carbons (common atom of incident bond pairs; deterministic leftovers). H is its own pick in expanded mode; condensed CHn selects the heavy atom (+group record). Independent cyan SVG overlay (`#mulerSelectLayerSvg`, mirrors the JSME g transform, pointer-events none) — no JSME background-channel use, so component highlights never clobber and vice versa; repaint hook at end of `fUpdateSVG` keeps it across repaints/zooms/mode switches (molecule/mode change drops contents, stays armed). Shift accumulates, plain click replaces (re-click clears), Esc/empty-canvas clears, invalid states fail closed. Verified headless: atom/bond/vertex/H/double-bond picks, shift/Esc/empty/mode-switch, zero page errors.
- Phase 1B follow-ups (v56 working tree): compacted-group pick — in free selection, clicking a compacted label (e.g. COOH) selects the whole fragment (anchors + skipped atoms, fail-closed on ambiguity; the main-chain-only carbon override is recorded below); halos render translucent (`fill-opacity 0.5`) under labels so text stays readable; empty-canvas click clears; stale group metadata cleared on bond picks.
- Phase 1B halos under content (v56 working tree, 2026-11-12): translucent sibling overlay (`#mulerSelectLayerSvg` + g-transform mirroring) replaced by opaque-cyan `<path data-muler-sel>` halos inserted right after the white bg rect inside the main JSME SVG, so labels/lines paint on top and text stays readable with no translucency. Paths only (never rect/text/line/g, circle, or polygon) so order maps, bond line groups, compacted-geometry circle scans, highlight scraping, and the logo strip stay blind to them; 2-line `data-muler-sel` skip guards added to both circle loops as future-proofing. `fMulerSelectClearLayer` clears halo paths (legacy overlay selector kept for one-generation overlap). `node --check` unavailable in this environment; `git diff --check` clean, brace/paren skew identical to HEAD, path-data shapes validated.
- Phase 1B look rework (v56 working tree, 2026-11-12, replaces the path halos above): under-content halos are dropped — label rects are white-filled and occluded them (cyan rim + white inside). Selection now paints through the native JSME background channel: palette slot 2 → `#22d3ee` (JSME slots are 1-based — slot N is `bgAtom[N-1]`; slot 9 green untouched), boot-time wrapper merges component + selection args per channel on every paint, so a pick looks exactly like the default highlight in cyan (same rects/rx/circles/bonds, opaque, text on top, all 3 modes, no DOM shapes). Precedence is component-wins (single merge-order switch); empty selection passes args through byte-identical. Clears go through applet resets (JSME ignores empty-string sets — setting `""` would add but never remove); resets re-apply selection-only (clear never wipes the pick); Present pushes component-only; molecule/mode change drops contents + recorded component set. Condensed hidden members (compacted FG atoms) are paint-filtered via the compaction skip set — only the anchor paints, the compact label inherits its fill; highlight circles near removed texts are dropped by a fill-restricted circle twin of the near-text collector. Install verified + self-healing retry; draft applet untouched. Still to verify on the browser machine: `node --check`, green-unchanged-with-selection-off, cyan look × atom/bond/vertex/H/compacted × 3 modes, overlap → green, clear-keeps-selection, molecule-switch drop, draft/Present.
- Phase 1B pick accuracy, root cause (v56 working tree, 2026-11-12): browser dumps proved the rect map off by one in compacted renders — the white canvas bg rect is collected as "near removed texts" and deleted every render, so the `rectIdx = 1` bg-skip eats the first label's rect and every rect-derived anchor sits one label right (text map was correct throughout). Fixes: (a) anchors prefer text centers via `getBBox` (visual truth, immune to rect-list surgery), rects only as fallback; (b) near-text collector skips index 0 (bg, same convention as the rect map). Still to verify on the browser machine: scripted center-picks return identity, real clicks match, rect census shows the bg surviving, green-vs-number alignment spot-check on a hetero branched molecule, skeletal acid/aldehyde O/vertex/bond picks (hetero anchors geometric via bond-endpoint proximity; C-side multi-line bond ends adopt the nearby resolved joint since the free-atom rule gave them to the far atom), hover ring on label/bond + no ring on empty canvas (rAF-throttled, DOM-only stroke ring, per-render geometry cache), `node --check`, screenshots.
- Quiz mode 1C (v56 working tree): name-box click while armed sets a quiz target (main chain first) instead of highlighting; live set-compare with exact/subset/wrong/disjoint verdicts, wrong picks reported by count in the verdict line (no red paint, per owner), exact match replays the classic green path as the reward. Sequence badges (pick-order numbers below each label, white text + cyan halo) + walk validation: consecutive picks must be bonded (direction enforced: C1-first order greens, full reverse gets a `direction` verdict, scrambled sets an `order` verdict; symmetric chains accept either direction (orienter-indifference oracle). Accepts any tied pool chain (auto-adopts a non-live match via the stepper path; adopted-only in data mode). Probe `probe-quiz.js` (ethane: arm → box → both carbons → green + success).
- Additive selection + exact paint (v56 working tree): plain clicks toggle atoms/bonds/fragments in/out (JSmol-style; shift identical), Esc/empty-canvas clears, kinds stay exclusive. Push is now reset-first per channel because JSME background sets accumulate — highlight always equals selection exactly. Mode hygiene: arming select clears all highlights + deselects components; disarming clears selection paint + arrays; exact quiz match clears the pick so green stands alone.
- Main-chain compacted-carbon picks (v56 working tree, 2026-11-13): when the selection purpose is main-chain (`compCarbonsCount` quiz target), a carbon-anchored compact label (`COOH`/`HOOC`/`HCOOH`/`CHO`/`OHC`/`CN`/`NC`) now selects its anchor carbon only, even from the whole-label/backplate hit area; free selection keeps the existing whole-fragment behavior, and N/S-anchored groups (`NO2`, future NOx/SOx) are never converted. Arming a main-chain target normalizes an already-selected compact carbon fragment to its anchor. Paint keeps the group backplate white, hides the oversized native atom ellipse, and draws a C-sized rounded path behind the carbon glyph; the sequence badge follows that glyph and hover previews the same atom box. `fMulerSelectNormalizeMainChainCompacts` owns the state collapse. Probe `tools/muler-harness/probe-compact-main.js` (free vs main, COOH/HCOOH/CN, NO2, hover, badge, exact reward).
- Main-chain compact-pick hardening (v56 working tree, 2026-11-13): the enlarged backplate hit area is now main-chain-only — free selection keeps the pre-v56 glyph-run box (`textBox`), so the wider backplate can no longer steal picks from adjacent atoms/bond stubs. The paint pass is idempotent (a `data-muler-compact-white` marker on the backplate it whitened, instead of re-testing the cyan fill), so a repaint that runs without a fresh JSME render cannot drop the C-only path after the clear step; a green component backplate is still never overpainted, and Present stays hidden. The C-sized path and the ellipse hide no longer require a tagged backplate, so a label without highlight geometry still gets the cue; the ellipse hide is ownership-guarded by the label backing rect so a neighboring atom's highlight is never hidden. Probe extended with the free-mode backplate edge, clear/marker restore and methanal.
- Skeletal vertex joints (v56 working tree, 2026-11-13): offset ends of multi-line bonds (parallel-line spacing, ~60 SVG units) are now merged into their true joint in `fMulerSelectVertices` before the vertex→atom assignment, so the joint's atom is resolved topologically instead of by the greedy free-atom rule. Fixes skeletal aldehydes (only one drawn single bond at the carbonyl carbon, so the old joint-adoption pass — which requires a multi-bond target — never fired): clicking the carbonyl carbon selected the oxygen in propanal/butanal/pentanal/propynal, while ethanal mapped the true joint to the methyl carbon and left the methyl end unresolved. Ketones/acids/esters keep their previous assignments; methanal is unchanged (no second bond to merge into). Probe `probe-skel-joints.js` (16 molecules: aldehydes, ketones, acids, ester, alkene, alkyne, nitrile, nitro): every vertex picks an endpoint of all its bonds, no unmerged multi-line offset end remains, and every carbonyl carbon's incident-bond line endpoints pick the carbon.
- Quiz verdicts are final-only (v56 working tree, 2026-11-13; supersedes the count-based intermediate verdicts above): while the user is picking, `fMulerQuizRefresh` leaves the verdict line hidden — no `◐ n/m σωστά`, no "some atoms are outside the main chain", no "no overlap" — and the arm prompt no longer shows the neutral "pick atoms" line. Final feedback stays: `exact` success (unchanged, green reward) plus `direction`/`order`, which only fire once the picked set already equals the target set (full reverse / scrambled complete set). The other kinds remain in `fMulerQuizVerdict` for future FG/branch targets but are not pushed during picking. `probe-quiz.js` now asserts silence on partial picks and on an out-of-chain branch atom, and still checks exact, direction and order. (Superseded by the live numberless hints below.)
- Quiz live numberless hints (2026-11-14; supersedes final-only silence): `fMulerQuizRefresh` now pushes live feedback with no chain-length leak and no pick positions — hetero (`quizHetero`) > gap (`quizGap`) > count (`quizMore`/`quizFewer` by unique-pick vs adopted target) > generic outside (`quizWrong` numberless). `direction`/`order` stay final-only on full-set equality; `exact` unchanged (green reward). Renderer adds `more/fewer/hetero/gap` kinds (CSS `mulerQuiz-*` classes); `subset` aliases to `more`, old count-interpolated texts retired. Probes: `probe-quiz.js` asserts live `more` on ethane 1/2 and branch carbon, `hetero` on O pick, `gap` on C1+C3 skip, plus unchanged exact/direction/order; `probe-mode-quiz`/`probe-explain-all` empty-selection silence unchanged.
- Selection mode owns the viewer (v56 working tree, 2026-11-13): changing the 2D style (condensed/expanded/skeletal) while selecting no longer paints the name-component highlight or overwrites the quiz prompt — `fExplainNameComp` returns early whenever select mode is armed, with a one-shot `__mulerQuizReward` opt-in from the exact verdict, so the green appears only as the success reward. A main-chain quiz target is a molecule-level atom set, so a style switch drops the selection contents but keeps the quiz armed and re-asserts its prompt (only a real molecule change disarms). Probe `probe-mode-quiz.js`: style cycle keeps zero green shapes, target/prompt/comp5 selection intact and the verdict hidden; picking the chain in the new style yields the success line + green; a post-exact switch stays clean; with select mode off the classic component highlight still paints and survives style switches. (Molecule-switch disarm superseded by sticky re-arm below.)
- Sticky-quiz re-arm on molecule switch (2026-11-14): sticky selection restores `comp5` but `PushState` disarmed the quiz, leaving select ON + comp selected + purpose free — condensed CHO/COOH then picked the whole fragment (hetero hint, never exact). `fShowNameAnalysis` tail now calls `fMulerQuizRearmSticky` (guarded: select armed, no Present/draft/replay, target clear, restored box quiz-capable + visible): re-sets the target, normalizes compacts, re-asserts prompt, refreshes + repaints. Style/eye/stepper rebuilds keep their target and skip. Probe `probe-coverage56.js` asserts re-armed target + prompt + carbon-only anchor pick post-switch.
- Explain-all overview in selection mode (v56 working tree, 2026-11-13): the overview table builds again while selecting instead of failing or nesting. `fNameExplainTableBuild` scrapes per-component explanation HTML from `#nameAnalysisExplain` after `fExplainNameComp`, so the selection-mode guard now also admits `__mulerExplainQuiet` builds (paints stay suppressed by that same flag); the scrape defensively rejects its own `explainTable` markup. Closing the overview in selection mode restores the quiz prompt (or clears the panel) instead of leaving the table behind, and an armed/exact quiz repaints the table when explain-all is on. Selection fill detection now derives hex and `rgb()` forms from `MULER_SELECT_CYAN` (palette `#6ddcbe` in the working tree) with legacy cyan retained, so the C-only compact paint and the compaction circle cleanup work with the current color. Probe `probe-explain-all.js`: 3 open/close cycles without a quiz, with a quiz, a style switch while open, and exact with the table open.
- Next: 3D picking spike (ROADMAP 1A gate) + 1C FG/branch resolvers; owner tweaks kept as-is (`selectAtomsBtn` 20px icon, `spt/init-3-56.spt` picking/measurement off).
- Review fixes (2026-11-13, this batch): `__mulerQuizReward` + `__mulerExplainQuiet` now `try/finally` (stuck-flag safe); draft teardown + toggle-off clear `groups`; `fToggleAtomSelect` blocks Present entry (was draft-only); sequence badges use `MULER_SELECT_CYAN` + `.mulerSelNum` class and verdicts use `#mulerQuizVerdict.*` classes (`css/jsme-nick-56.css`); vertex/joint EPS now zoom-relative (median-bond derived, clamped, absolute fallback) with `fMulerSelectVertexAtoms(verts, groups)`; `molKey` documents view-only stability (eye/stepper keep indices, repaint only); legacy `#22d3ee` retained with removal timeline; `spt/init-3.spt` restored for v55 + new `spt/init-3-56.spt` (picking/measurement off) for v56 (`molview-56.js` retargeted); harness log-only probes promoted to hard-fail (`smoke56/final/pick7/shift/frag2`), env `MULER_CHROME`/`MULER_BASE`, `waitForFunction` ready gates, CTM-derived clicks (no hard screen coords), new `probe-coverage56.js` (H pick, molecule-switch, allowSelect gating, Present block). `node --check` still pending on the browser machine (no node here); `git diff --check` clean.

## [v55] (tiered 3D for drafts; LIVE, `index.html` → v55)

Forked from v54 (`mulermoc-nom-55.html` + `js/*-55.js` + `css/*-55.css`, `?v=55.0`). Draft 3D is now 3-tier: PubChem SDF → JSmol remote `load $SMILES` (`fMolDraftRemote3DFromJSmol`: applet proxy-routed, works CDN + local, no page-side fetch so no CORS wall; scriptWait + SDF read-back, validated) → local 2D-MOL + UFF minimize in JSmol (offline, `fMolDraftLocal3DFromMol`: inline `load data` + `add hydrogens` + blocking `minimize steps 500` via scriptWait — fire-and-forget raced read-back with pre-minimize coords — then SDF extracted back via `molFile`/`show MOL`, validated by `fMolDraftValidSDF3D` heavy-count + non-flat-z). Orchestrated by `fMolDraftFetchSDF3DTiered` with epoch/submitId guards; preview shows source-labeled 3D row (local flagged provisional), fetching note, all-miss 2D-only note. Accept ungated on any tier success (was PubChem-3D-only); provenance persisted as `sdf3DSource` (rec + update path + history + save-file headers). SDF read-back is `write MOL` alone (translate-test proved it the sole live-model serializer: `molFile` returns an unparseable layout, `fileContents` is a stale dump), logging length + heavy count + heavy-only z-spread + verdict. The V2000 parser now reads z (flat-2D text correctly fails the non-flat check, spread over heavies only so H-noise can't fake 3D). The planar-saddle trap (exactly-flat input freezes MMFF: zero heavy displacement) plus E=46000+ overlap divergence are broken by a pure-JS 2D untangle (spreads non-bonded heavy overlaps) + z-jiggle (±0.3 Å), both self-verifying, with tier-3 acceptance requiring heavy displacement vs the prepared input (`fMolDraftMovedEnough`, mean ≥ 0.05 Å) plus plain-`minimize` retry; `zap`-first loads with `calculate hydrogens`, live load-verify (heavy count + matches-loaded ≈ 0), always-show-flat-3D on total miss, and a manual Minimize-3D fallback button in the preview: pressing it runs the pipeline, then an OK-only dialog asks to save the 3D conformation once optimization completes — OK stores best-effort (`jsmol-min` when validated, `jsmol-unminimized` live model otherwise) and unlocks Accept (ESC/backdrop = back out, stay locked). Minimize is fire-and-forget (follow-up scripts interrupt the in-flight run — console-proven) with a single delayed read-back, explicit MMFF-then-UFF force fields, and iterative re-minimize from the live model on repeat presses (movement judged vs the pre-fire snapshot, no convergence requirement — partial descent counts). `?v=55.0` unchanged across all v55 commits — hard-reload (Ctrl+Shift+R) after pulling. No naming-engine changes.
